items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: the Navy sent a Chief Musician out to our union meetings... the Chief stayed [in a compartment on the train]... One day the Chief said, 'Okay, no more sessions.'

ctx.x: Can I ask how old you were when you got called up?

I was 22, yeah 22 years old. Let’s see around June or July, the Navy sent a Chief Musician out to our union meetings. See we used to have separate union meetings. A black union, we would meet in Oakland at the Elks building there. They had a building with a bar upstairs and there was quite a building, a very nice building. And we would hold our meetings there. Because we were a subsidiary. And we weren’t allowed access to the Local 6 musicians headquarters. But anyhow the Navy, they sent a Chief out to recruit…
In your head, were you thinking it’s this or perhaps the infantry?
